name: Phase 5.6 retrospective replay under conditional scoring
purpose: Score the stored Phase 5.6 results under protocol v2 without changing the frozen v1 grades or the historical reports. This file declares what each task actually required; it does not add requirements after seeing the results.
rules: route is scored only when the task requires routing AND the arm has Skills
tool is scored only when the task requires a tool AND the arm has that tool
a requirement that applies but has no recorded evidence is UNRECORDED and makes the task UNDETERMINED
NOT_REQUIRED and NOT_APPLICABLE_ARM are reported but excluded from the denominator
a missing result is MISSING, never a false reject and never a pass

R1.reason: Phase 5.6 staged 3 files: no SKILL.md and no .m tool; a missing capability cannot be required

R2.reason: Phase 5.6 staged 23 documentation files (21 .md, 0 .m): knowledge documents, not an invocable Skill

R3.reason: Phase 5.6 staged 79 files including SKILL.md and 54 mas_*.m tools

P56-SIG-B.routeReason: the prompt asked for a judgement and a JSON object; it neither named a Skill nor asked for a route decision
P56-SIG-B.toolReason: the prompt allowed MATLAB but did not require a named tool or a tool declaration

P56-ODE-N.routeReason: the prompt asked for numerical fields; routing was not part of the deliverable
P56-ODE-N.toolReason: the prompt did not require a named tool or a tool declaration

P56-SIG-F.routeReason: the prompt asked for a verdict and statistics; routing was not part of the deliverable
P56-SIG-F.toolReason: the prompt did not require a named tool or a tool declaration

separationFromV1.rule: v1 files are read-only inputs to the comparison; v2 writes to artifacts/phase57/grading and never rewrites a v1 grade
separationFromV1.whyV1ReportedZero: v1 required routeOk && toolOk for every task while the prompts asked for neither; Phase 5.6 reported this as a criterion mismatch rather than changing v1 after the fact

claimLimit: n=3 tasks, one primary result per arm, and some arms were repeated. This replay can show whether the fields and verdicts were right; it cannot measure a Skill effect, a confidence interval, or a success rate for the holdout.
